name: edit only allowed tokens in a tex include using a synonym map
definition: rewrite a subordinate tex file by swapping words to permitted synonyms while leaving the main frame and the allowed-synonym list byte-identical.
failure_mode: touching the protected files, or building a non-identical input, fails the immutability check

name: execute a multi-step digest derivation over binary input
definition: Implement the implied sequence of hashing, concatenating truncated outputs, and mixing them in the specified order so the printed value reproduces the intended digest.
failure_mode: Omitting a truncation, changing concatenation order, or using the wrong digest algorithm changes the output.

name: execute the legacy code in an appropriate emulator and capture output
definition: Set up a software emulator/interpreter/host for that architecture (including setting up one running in an automated browser via a driver) and run the binary to obtain the program's printed arithmetic output.
failure_mode: No emulator or wrong one means no runnable execution and no output.

name: exit the game cleanly so state flushes to the database
definition: quit the game via its normal exit path so the in-memory state is written to the db rows before the session ends.
failure_mode: killing or aborting the process before a clean exit leaves the db unwritten/empty
